left.raw_text: Diagnosis: Diagnosis of CP secondary to neuronal migration
Co-morbidities: Medical conditions that may prevent the administration of rehabilitation therapies at the intensity required by the study
or that may compromise the study ability to maintain blindness
or that have a co-morbidity not typically associated with CP (i.e. cancer, cystic fibrosis)
Co-interventions: Anticipated pharmacological intervention or procedure
or participation in other studies that may interfere with this study
